goal: Prevent incoming Tor connections from inheriting whitelist permissions assigned to the local Tor daemon
Require nodes using automatic Tor listening to configure a dedicated, non-wildcard onion bind
agreement: General support for requiring dedicated onion binds (jeanpablojp, winterrdog, vasild)
Unaddressed objection: disallowing wildcard binds conflicts with dynamic IPs in containers (schildbach)
Suggestions to correct error messages and drop a redundant startup check remain open (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because anonymous Tor peers sharing a bind with direct IP traffic can inherit whitelist privileges
Misclassifying Tor traffic as local IP connections creates privilege escalation and ban evasion hazards
